motion: Handheld follow shot, right to left, as a barista carries two stacked trays around the corner of the espresso bar. The trays stay in her hands for the whole shot. Dim interior practicals and a thin dawn glow skim the metal surfaces, and the fixtures behind her hold still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Fast push-in on a row of paper cups as a hand enters from frame right and turns one cup a quarter turn to face the camera. The hand stays on that cup. Steam rises from the espresso machine behind the bar. The other cups and the counter hold still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Hard tracking shot, left to right, as the barista in the green apron lifts a stack of cup sleeves off the shelf and holds it against her chest. The stack stays in her hands until the end of the shot. Cold fluorescent prep-room light is flat and unchanging. The fridge, its door, the sheets of paper taped to it and the door behind her stay exactly as the first frame shows them, and the air in the room is still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Crash-zoom into the pressure gauge as a hand enters from frame left and presses the brew control. The hand stays on the control. Steam rises from the group head beside it and the gauge needle climbs. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Rack focus from a waiting customer's shoulder in the foreground to the barista in the midground as she walks left to right from the espresso bar to the register. Early morning window light lies flat across the counter and the clock's second hand above her advances. The queue holds still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Static locked-off shot as the barista walks in from frame right and stops at the centre of the counter. Dawn light through the window is even and unchanging and the reflections on the steel hold steady. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Slow dolly-in on the barista's hands as she straightens a row of order tickets into a neat line. Her hands stay on the tickets. The lids, the syrup bottles and everything else on the bar hold still, and the air in the room is still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Gentle handheld pan from a second barista's writing hand to the lead barista as she reaches in from frame left and puts her hand flat on the tray of cups to stop it. Her hand stays on the tray. Steam rises from the espresso machine behind them and the order tickets above the bar hang still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Handheld follow as the barista sets a fresh cup down into the row on the counter and leaves it standing there. Steam rises from the espresso machine, and beyond the counter the blurred queue of adults shifts slowly. The cups already in the row hold still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Rack focus from a half-empty tray in the foreground to the barista as she steps in from frame left and looks down at it. Cold fluorescent light overhead is flat and unchanging. The door behind her, the stacks of sleeves and the steel table stay exactly as the first frame shows them, and the air in the room is still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Slow lateral slider move, right to left, as the barista's hands press a loose pile of cup sleeves down into one tidy stack. The stack stays under her hands. Cold fluorescent light overhead is flat and unchanging, the door behind her holds still, and the air in the room is still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Gentle push-in toward the espresso machine as the barista leans in close to read the pressure gauges. Steam rises from the group head and behind the counter the blurred queue of adults holds steady. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Rack focus from the barista's hand on the portafilter to the pressure gauge as she twists the portafilter clockwise into the group head. The portafilter stays in her hand. Steam rises from the machine and the drip tray below holds still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Handheld follow as the barista holds a finished cup out from centre frame toward frame right. The cup stays in her hand for the whole shot. Steam rises behind her and the blurred adults near the counter move slowly left to right. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Slow dolly-in on a figure standing near frame left, looking off into the distance past the camera. She stays where she is. Late afternoon sun through the window lies still across the empty tables, with dust motes turning slowly in the shaft of light. The chairs and tables hold still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.

Static locked-off shot as the barista wipes the counter from left to right with a folded cloth. The cloth stays in her hand. Evening light in the windows is steady and a last thread of steam rises from the cooling machine. Everything else on the bar holds still. Photorealistic, Motivational mood, cinematic.
